description: Build a SwapChan deep link that opens swapchan.com with the swap card prefilled and auto-quoted, plus a permanent, unguessable short link (swapchan.com/s/<id>, random id, swap links do not expire). Accepts chain names or ids, token symbols or addresses, a decimal amount or "max" (needs owner), optional recipient (cross-VM) and ref (partner id, keeps attribution). Scheme: https://swapchan.com/swap?fromChain=&fromToken=&amount=&toChain=&toToken=&recipient=&ref=. Pass items[] instead to get ONE batch link that steps through several swaps. Use this whenever you want to hand the user a one-click swap. Result includes `display` markdown with chan images: show it to the user. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).
